content.title: Dallas St. Patrick's Day Parade & Festival 2026 | Visit Dallas
content.text: Lower Greenville St. Patrick's Day Block Party Don't miss the annual Lower Greenville St. Patrick's Day Block Party! The block party will occur during the parade and festival, featuring live music, delectable bites, and more. Watch talented performances on three stages, experience a beer tasting, and try culinary delights from local restaurants. Date & Times - Saturday, March 14 | 9:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. (bars stay open until 2:00 a.m.) Location - 2908 Greenville Ave, Dallas, TX 75206 St. Patrick's Day Parade & Festival Dates & Hours Date - Saturday, March 14, 2026Parade Start - 11:00 a.m.Festival Hours - 9:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. Parade & Festival Location & Directions Parade Starting Point - Blackwell Street and Greenville Avenue, running south on Greenville Avenue | 11:00 a.m. Parade Ending Point - SMU Boulevard | 2:00 p.m. Getting there - The parade route starts on Greenville Avenue at Blackwell Street and ends at SMU Boulevard at Central Expressway. Parade-goers are encouraged to ride share or ride the DART Rail, as parking is extremely limited. Recommended DART Rail stations include Mockingbird Station, Lovers Lane Station, and Park Lane Station. The parade is free to attend. Featured Experiences The parade features more than 90 colorful floats, food trucks, local vendors, family-friendly activities and more. Don’t miss the Dallas St. Patrick’s Parade Official Concert after the parade, located at Energy Square! Previous headliners have included major acts like Jimmy Eat World, Third Eye Blind and Toadies. More Ways to Celebrate St. Patrick's Day Start the day with the St. Paddy's Day Dash 5K at Energy Square! Held on March 14 and running from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., don your shamrock-themed gear and run through an upbeat atmosphere. Bask in St. Patrick's Day excitement with mouthwatering eats, refreshing beer, and exciting prizes during this 5K run. Expand your spring holiday itinerary with visits to a variety of popular breweries, enjoying craft brews and local flavors. Explore More
